# Introduction
- What's Today?
  - People sometimes struggles with what leisure activities would they do.
  - Users can filter through suggested leisure activities 
    - Find activities based on age, time of day, and location
    - New York City events based on category of event
  - Interactive dashboard complied of ATUS and Meetup.com data
    - Dynamic tables and visualizations that update immediately with user selections

# Data and Methodology
- American Time Use Survey (ATUS)
  - Existing datasets  (\href{https://www.bls.gov/tus/home.htm}{US Bureau of Labor Statistics})
  - Measures the amount of time people spend doing various activities
  - Merging Resp, Roster, & Activity files
  - Selecting relevant columns, recoding numerical codes to text labels
  - Descriptive statistics (frequency distribution, mean duration, etc.)
  
- Meetup.com
  - Scrapped the website
    - Name
    - Date & time
    - Group/organization
  - Chromote
